score: At each homologous site, N_c=sum_ch abs(H_c-P_c_previous), M_c=sum_ch abs(H_c), score N_n/(M_m+epsilon). Cross numerator source n and magnitude source m. Reconstruct directly from C-contiguous float32 descriptors and causal EMA; never invert a rounded mean to recover N. Update EMA at all sites only after scoring.
precondition: All five recordings must pass same-source pointwise score identity and all-capacity exact mask identity to parent EMA/current, plus absolute/activity reference identity, before any new candidate replay
comparison: 2 numerator sources x2 denominator sources, plus absolute/activity references, crossed with each fixed detector candidate stream. All 3 capacity and 3 previously frozen threshold regimes; no new threshold search
decomposition: Within one fixed output/regime/capacity, four cells share own-dense and full-GT denominators. Order y00,y01,y10,y11 is N_O/M_O,N_O/M_A,N_A/M_O,N_A/M_A. Numerator average=((y10-y00)+(y11-y01))/2; magnitude-denominator average=((y01-y00)+(y11-y10))/2. Report interaction and order-specific effects; descriptive arithmetic only.
paired_patterns: Count all16 own-dense identity hit signatures in cell order00/01/10/11; among OO-hit/AA-miss cases, report recovery by numerator reversion (01), denominator reversion (10), both individually, or neither individually. Retain diagonal gains, full-GT TP and FP; these are offline counterfactual diagnostics, not deployable oracle decisions.
interpretation_forks: Magnitude-denominator domination that persists at both common numeric thresholds supports a local denominator-sensitive explanation
Numerator domination or large interaction rejects a denominator-only explanation
Opposite signs across recordings reject universal adaptation damage; retain Zurich02 and every other group
limits: Already exposed development recordings; same architecture, two checkpoints, one adaptation-order seed
Hybrid factors can be out of distribution and are software interventions, not independent biological or environmental causes
Numerator changes both current representation and prediction; not predictor quality alone
No new inference, training, calibration, importance algorithm, physical skip, energy or safety evidence
Position capacity and numeric threshold equality do not imply total compute or evaluation-FP matching
